blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Sphere Encoder is an autoencoder that generates images by decoding random points from a high-dimensional latent sphere.
We identify two limitations of the original formulation that reduce its generation quality.
First, random points concentrate near the equator relative to the pole on an encoded latent, but the training rotation never reaches this region, leaving a gap that limits one-step generation.
Second, training for generation with pixel-wise reconstruction loss encourages the decoder to average over plausible images, producing blurry images that lack high-frequency details.
We present Sphere Encoder 2 to address both limitations, substantially improving image generation quality while maintaining the speed and simplicity of a autoencoder.
Models are released at github.com/kaiyuyue/sphere2 .
blocks.zh:
球形编码器(Sphere Encoder)是一种自定义编码器,它通过从高维潜在球面解码出随机点来生成图像.
我们查明了原始表述中降低其生成质量的两个局限性。
首先,随机点集中在赤道附近相对于极地的被编码的潜伏上,但训练自转从未到达这个区域,从而留下了限制一步生成的缺口.
第二,对一代人进行视像素重建损失的培训,鼓励解码器平均超过可信图像,产生模糊的图像,缺乏高频细节。
我们提出Sphere Encoder 2,以解决这两个局限性,大大提高了图像生成质量,同时保持了自动编码器的速度和简便.
模式发布于github.com/kaiyuyue/sphere2.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Sphere Encoders ( Yue et al., 2026 ; Do et al., 2026 ; Man et al., 2026 ) are simple standalone autoencoders with strong generative capabilities. They consist of an encoder that maps images into a spherical latent space, and a decoder that maps a latent vector back to an image. When trained properly, the training images cover the latent sphere with an approximately uniform distribution, enabling generation of novel images by sampling a random latent vector and passing it through the decoder. Unlike the many-step generation process used by diffusion models, sphere encoders enable fast image generation in as little as one step.
blocks.zh: 球形编码器 (Yue等,2026;Do等,2026;Man等,2026)是简单独立的自编码器,具有很强的基因能力. 它们包括一个将图像映射到球状潜在空间的编码器,以及一个将潜在向量映射回图像的解码器. 如果培训得当,培训图像以大致一致的分布覆盖了潜在领域,通过取样随机潜在矢量并经过解码器来生成新图像。 与扩散模型使用的多步生成过程不同,球形编码器可以使快成像生成速度快到一步.

blocks.en:
The original Sphere Encoder ( Yue et al., 2026 ) is able to represent the ImageNet distribution, but its single-step generations are blurry ( Fig. 2 , top). Sharp images were obtained by iteratively passing a generated image through the encoder and decoder as many as 4 times, yet soft edges remain even after this refinement.
We trace this to two causes.
First, while noise is added to latent vectors during training to achieve good coverage of the sphere, the original Sphere Encoder only adds up to 85 ∘ 85^{\circ} of noise to latents, possibly leaving some of the sphere unseen during training.
Second, it trains the decoder for generation with the pixel-wise reconstruction loss, which is minimized by averaging over all plausible images and thus yields blurry outputs.
blocks.zh:
最初的球形编码器(Yue等,2026年)能够代表ImageNet的分布,但其单步相传的后代模糊(图2,上). 尖锐的图像是通过迭代地通过编码器和解码器来传递所生成的图像而得到的,有多达4倍之多,然而软边缘即使在这一改进后仍然保留.
我们追踪到两个原因。
首先,在培训期间,噪音被添加到潜在向量中,以实现球体的好覆盖,而最初的球形编码器却只将噪音加到85-----85---Circ}潜入到潜入中,有可能在培训期间将一些球体隐去.
第二,它用像素-视像素的重建损失来训练一代的解码器,通过在所有可信的图像上平均计算,可以尽量减少这种损失,从而产生模糊的输出。

blocks.en: Sphere Encoder 2 fixes both issues ( Fig. 2 , bottom). First, we adopt a parameterization of noise that robustly adds a full 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} of noise to latents during training, allowing the decoder to see more of the sphere during training. Second, we decouple the decoder’s task into two regimes: low-noise reconstruction, which keeps the pixel-wise loss, and high-noise generation, which drops it. In the high-noise/generative regime, we propose a new and efficient latent score matching loss. This encourages outputs to lie on the image manifold without requiring adversarial training. The result is sharp one-step generation on ImageNet 512 × 512 512\times 512 ( Fig. 1 ).
blocks.zh: 球形编码器2解决了两个问题(图2,下方). 首先,我们采用了噪声参数化方法,在训练期间将90个---90--Circ]的全部噪声加到潜伏物上,使解码器在训练期间能看到更多的球体. 第二,我们把解码器的任务拆分成两个制度:低噪声重建,使像素减退,而高噪声代代,则使其下降。 在高噪音/再生制度下,我们提出一个新的、高效的潜在得分匹配损失。 这鼓励产出在形象上多管齐下,而不需要进行对抗性培训。 结果在ImageNet512×512 512\times 512(图1)上出现了尖锐的一阶生成.

blocks.en:
Among pixel-space generators on ImageNet, Sphere Encoder 2 achieves the best FDr 6 at 256 × 256 256\times 256 and the second best at 512 × 512 512\times 512 with only 4 × 2 4\times 2 network evaluations (NFE), whereas pixel diffusion models such as JiT ( Li & He, 2026 ) and PixNerd ( Wang et al., 2026a ) take 200.
This amounts to 23 × 23\times to 40 × 40\times less sampling compute in total GFLOPs.
Without classifier-free guidance (CFG) ( Ho & Salimans, 2022 ) , 4 steps outperform JiT-H and one-step pMF-H ( Lu et al., 2026 ) at both resolutions.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Autoencoders ( Bourlard & Kamp, 1988 ; Hinton & Zemel, 1993 ; Kingma & Welling, 2014 ) compress images into a latent space, but making them generate on their own is hard on complex datasets, e.g. , ImageNet ( Deng et al., 2009 ) .
Hierarchical VAEs such as NVAE ( Vahdat & Kautz, 2020 ) and VDVAE ( Child, 2021 ) deepen the latent space, yet their generation quality stays far below diffusion models ( Dhariwal & Nichol, 2021 ) and GANs ( Sauer et al., 2023 ) .
Deep VAEs ( Luhman & Luhman, 2023 ) reach high fidelity on ImageNet only when trained inside the latent space of a pretrained tokenizer.
Autoencoders then settled for the two-stage paradigm: an autoencoder only compresses, and a secondary latent diffusion Rombach et al. (2022) or autoregressive (AR) prior ( Tian et al., 2024 ) generates.
Sphere Encoder ( Yue et al., 2026 ) revisits single-stage paradigm with a non-variational autoencoder and reaches competitive quality on ImageNet, but its generation is blurry because it treats generation as reconstruction.
Sphere Encoder 2 still stays single-stage but removes the blur.
blocks.zh:
自动编码器(Bourlard & Kamp,1988;Hinton & Zemel,1993;Kingma & Welling,2014)将图像压缩成潜伏的空间,但使其自行生成在复杂的数据集上很困难,例如ImageNet(Deng等,2009年).
NVAE(Vahdat & Kautz, 2020年)和VDVAE(Child, 2021年)等分级的VAE加深了潜在的空间,但其生成质量仍然远远低于扩散模型(Dhariwal & Nichol, 2021年)和GANs(Sauer等, 2023年).
深度VAEs(Luhman & Luhman, 2023年)在ImageNet上达到高忠诚度, 只有在经过预先训练的标语器潜入空间内训练.
自动编码器随后为双相范式定居:自动编码器只可压缩,二级潜在扩散Rombach等人(2022年)或自递(AR)先(Tian等,2024年)生成.
球形编码器 (Yue等,2026年)以非变相自编码器重温了单相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相

blocks.en:
Sampling from a prior is what turns an autoencoder into a generator, and most work focuses on learning a richer prior, from mixture priors ( Tomczak & Welling, 2018 ) to the hierarchical priors above.
Spherical latents have also been explored, but either at small scale with a von Mises-Fisher posterior ( Davidson et al., 2018 ) , or with a prior still learned on top of spherical latents, autoregressive in SphereAR ( Ke & Xue, 2025 ) and Riemannian flow matching over representation-encoder latents in RJF ( Kumar & Patel, 2026 ) .
Sphere Latent Encoder ( Do et al., 2026 ) builds on Sphere Encoder without a learned prior, but it is two-stage again and relies on a RAE decoder ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) to reach pixels.
StyleGAN ( Karras et al., 2019 ) normalizes its input noise onto a sphere, but it does not synthesize from the sphere directly: a learned mapping network first transforms random inputs into the intermediate latent space 𝒲 \mathcal{W} , whose distribution is also a learned prior.
Closest to our setting, ( Zhao et al., 2019 ) decode random points on a sphere directly to pixels, but only working on MNIST and CelebA.
Sphere Encoder is the first to scale sphere-to-pixel decoding to ImageNet: the decoder is trained with noise to cover the entire sphere, so no learned prior is needed.
blocks.zh:
从前作的样本是将自动编码器变成生成器,大部分工作侧重于学习更丰富的前作,从混合前作(Tomczak & Welling, 2018)到以上分级前作.
也探索了球状潜质,但或用冯·米塞斯-费舍后传(Davidson等人,2018年)进行小规模的探索,或用之前在球状潜质上仍然学到的知识,在球状潜质(Ke & Xue,2025年)和里曼流相比于RJF中的代表-编码潜质(Kumar & Patel,2026年).
Sphere Latent Encoder (Do等,2026年) 以Sphere Encoder为主而未事先学习过,但它又是两相并依靠RAE解码器(Zheng等,2026年)来达到像素.
StyleGAN(Karras等,2019年)将输入噪声常态化到一个球上,但是它并没有直接从球上合成:一个有学识的映射网络首先将随机输入转化为中间潜入空间W\mathcal{W},其分布也是被学习到的前作.
最接近我们的设定, (Zhao等, 2019年) 将球体上的随机点直接解码为像素, 但只工作于 MNIST和 CelebA.
Sphere Encoder是第一个将球面到像素解码到ImageNet的尺度化:解码器被用噪音训练来覆盖整个球面,所以不需要事先学到的.

blocks.en:
One-step and few-step generation can be reached by two main paths.
Distillation compresses a pretrained multi-step teacher into a few steps, by progressively halving steps ( Salimans & Ho, 2022 ; Meng et al., 2023 ; Luhman & Luhman, 2021 ) , straightening trajectories ( Liu et al., 2022 ; Liu et al., 2024 ) , enforcing consistency ( Song et al., 2023 ; Kim et al., 2024 ) , or matching scores or distributions ( Luo et al., 2023b ; Yin et al., 2024b ; Yin et al., 2024a ; Zhou et al., 2024 ) , optionally with an adversarial term ( Sauer et al., 2024 ) , while from-scratch methods train one/few-step models directly, including consistency training ( Song et al., 2023 ; Song & Dhariwal, 2024 ; Geng et al., 2025b ; Lu & Song, 2025 ; Luo et al., 2023a ) , flow-map methods such as shortcut models, IMM, MeanFlow and its variants ( Frans et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2025 ; Geng et al., 2025a ; Geng et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2026 ; Boffi et al., 2024 ) , drifting models ( Deng et al., 2026 ) , GANs ( Goodfellow et al., 2020 ; Brock et al., 2019 ; Kang et al., 2023 ; Huang et al., 2024 ; Sauer et al., 2023 ; Hyun et al., 2026 ) , and Sphere Encoders ( Yue et al., 2026 ; Do et al., 2026 ; Man et al., 2026 ) .
Sphere Encoder 2 is trained from scratch without distillation.
One step decodes random points on the sphere directly into pixels, and each extra step loops the model by encoding, rotating, and decoding.
blocks.zh:
单步和几步生成可以通过两种主要路径来达到.
分解将经过预先培训的多步骤教师压缩成几个步骤,方法是逐步将步骤减半(Salimans & Ho, 2022;Meng等人, 2023;Luhman & Luhman, 2021;),理顺轨迹(Liu等人, 2022;Liu等人, 2024),执行一致性(Song等人, 2023;Kim等人, 2024),或比对分或分配(Luo等人, 2023b; Yin等, 2024b; Yin等, 2024a; Zhou等, 2024 ),可选用对抗性术语(Sauer等, 2024 ),而从划线方法直接训练出一出/分步走的模型,包括一致性培训(Song等, 2023; Song & Dhariwal, 2023), 2024; Geng等,2025b; Lu & Song等,2025; Lu等,2023a.),流图方法,如捷径模型,IMM, MeanFlow等(Frans等,2025;Zhou等,2025;Geng等,2025a;Geng等,2026;Lu等,2026;Boffi等,2024;漂流模型(Deng等,2026);GANs(Goodfellow等,2020;Brock等,2019;Kang等,2023;Huang等,2024;Sauer等,2023;Hyun等,2026;和Sphee Encoders(Yue等,2026;Do等,2026;Man等,2026)。
球形编码器2从零开始训练,没有蒸馏.
一步将球体上的随机点直接解码为像素,而每个额外的步骤通过编码,旋转,解码来循环模型.

blocks.en:
Distribution matching is the core of generative modeling for high-fidelity synthesis.
The most effective method is the adversarial loss: a discriminator learns to tell real images from generated ones, and its gradient pushes the generator toward the data distribution ( Goodfellow et al., 2020 ; Brock et al., 2019 ; Kang et al., 2023 ) .
However, adversarial training needs careful tuning and architecture design ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Hyun et al., 2026 ) , and its stability is a problem: BigGAN ( Brock et al., 2019 ) collapses after a few hundred ImageNet epochs and must be stopped early, and the discriminator overfits as training proceeds ( Karras et al., 2020 ) .
Distribution matching distillation (DMD) ( Yin et al., 2024b ) proposes an alternative: a pretrained diffusion teacher provides the real score, a second model tracks the fake score online, and their difference moves samples toward the data distribution ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ) .
The cost is the teacher: DMD requires a pretrained diffusion model of the same data or a superset of it, so it is a distillation method rather than a standalone loss for any generator.
SMT ( Jayashankar et al., 2025 ) tries to drop the teacher by learning the score of the real/fake mixture online, but operates in pixel space at 64 × 64 64\times 64 or below.
Concurrent work matches real and generated features of frozen encoders with MMD or optimal transport ( Feng et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) , estimating the transport direction non-parametrically from a batch, but so far only as post-training of pretrained multi-step generators.
In this work, we propose a lightweight score matching loss without a pretrained teacher.
It trains two score models online from scratch, one for real and one for fake features, each a two-layer transformer following standard EDM ( Karras et al., 2022 ) , and both operate in a frozen feature space rather than pixel space, as in Projected GAN ( Sauer et al., 2021 ) , StyleGAN-T ( Sauer et al., 2023 ) , and drifting loss ( Deng et al., 2026 ) .
Like a GAN loss, the score matching loss depends only on real and generated images, not on the generator itself, so in principle it can be plugged into any generator training pipeline.
blocks.zh:
分布相配是高纯度合成基因模型的核心.
最有效的方法是对抗损失:歧视者从生成的图像中得知真实图像,其梯度将生成者推向数据分布(Goodfellow等,2020;Brock等,2019;Kang等,2023)。
然而,对抗性训练需要仔细地进行调和和建筑设计(Huang等,2024;Hyun等,2026),其稳定性是一个问题: BigGAN(Brock等,2019年) 在几百个ImageNet时代后倒闭,必须及早被阻止,而歧视者过度地作为训练开始(Karras等,2020年).
分布相匹配蒸馏(DMD)(Yin等,2024b)提出一个替代方案:一个经过预训的传播老师提供真实分数,第二个模型在线跟踪假分数,它们的分数将样本移动到数据分布(Wang等,2023;周等,2024).
成本是老师:DMD需要预先训练的同一数据的传播模型或超集,因此它是蒸馏方法,而不是任何生成器的独立损失.
SMT(Jayashankar等,2025年)试图通过在线学习真相/假相混合物的分数来降低老师,但运行在像素空间64×64 64\times 64或以下.
同时期工作将被冻结的编码器真实并生成的特性与MMD或优化运输相匹配(冯等,2026;张等,2026),从批量估算出运输方向非参数化,但迄今为止只能是预训多步发电机的后期训练.
在这部作品中,我们提出一个轻量级分数匹配损失,而没有经过预先训练的老师.
它从零开始在网络上训练出两个分数模型,一个是真实的,另一个是假的特性,每个变压器遵循标准的EDM(Karras等人,2022年),两者都运行在一个被冻结的地物空间而不是像素空间,如预测GAN(Sauer等人,2021年),Style GAN-T (Sauer等, 2023年),和漂流损失 (Deng等, 2026年).
和GAN损失一样,分数匹配损失只取决于真实和生成的图像,而不是发电机本身,因此原则上可以被插入任何发电机训练管.

blocks.en: 4.4 Taming the Generation Regime
blocks.zh: 4.4 打击世代政权

blocks.en:
Reconstruction has been well studied in prior work ( Yao et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2026 ; Esser et al., 2024 ; Yue et al., 2026 ) , and is not the focus of this work.
We keep the reconstruction regime as is, without adversarial sharpening, so that any change in generation quality can be attributed to the generation losses alone.
Our focus in this work is the generation regime, with the goal set above: along the rotation arc in Fig. 3 , generated images should stay semantically consistent with the reconstruction while varying in appearance and structure.

blocks.en: 4.4.2 Fidelity Improvement
blocks.zh: 4.4.2 改进工作

blocks.en:
Improving synthesis fidelity with a loss is a long-standing problem in generative modeling.
The adversarial loss ( Goodfellow et al., 2020 ; Brock et al., 2019 ; Kang et al., 2023 ) remains the most effective approach, but it requires careful tuning and architecture design ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Hyun et al., 2026 ) , and its long training suffers from stability issues ( Karras et al., 2020 ) .
blocks.zh:
以亏损改善合成忠心度是基因模型制作中长期存在的问题.
对抗性损失(Goodfellow等,2020年;Brock等,2019年;Kang等,2023年)仍然是最有效的方法,但需要仔细地进行调制和建筑设计(Huang等,2024年;Hyun等,2026年),其长期训练存在稳定性问题(Karras等,2020年).

blocks.en:
We seek a simple alternative with two properties: (1) it is stable over long training on large datasets, e.g. , hundreds of epochs on ImageNet; and (2) it consistently yields effective fidelity supervision as the generator improves, rather than saturating once the generator catches up.
Inspired by DMD ( Yin et al., 2024b ; Deng et al., 2026 ) , we propose a score matching loss that is agnostic to the generator and plugs in as a standalone loss module, in the same way as a GAN loss.
blocks.zh:
我们寻求一种具有两种特性的简单替代方法:(1) 它在大型数据集的长期训练中是稳定的,例如,在ImageNet上的数百个时代;和(2) 随着发电机的改进,它不断产生有效的忠诚监督,而不是在发电机赶上后饱和.
由 DMD (Yin等, 2024b; Deng等, 2026)所启发, 我们提出一个比分损失, 对发电机不可知, 并插入作为独立损失模块, 与GAN损失相同.

Like a GAN loss, it trains an auxiliary model online alongside the generator, but instead of a discriminator that classifies real from fake, it trains two lightweight score models, each only two transformer layers following standard EDM ( Karras et al., 2022 ) , that estimate the real and fake distributions in a frozen feature space; their difference gives the direction to move fake features toward real ones.
Like a discriminator ( Reed et al., 2016 ; Sauer et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2018a ; Kang et al., 2023 ; Sauer et al., 2024 ) , the score models can be unconditional or conditioned on the class or caption.

如歧视者(Reed等,2016;Sauer等,2023;Zhang等,2018a;Kang等,2023;Sauer等,2024),分数模型可以无条件或以分数或标题为条件.

blocks.en:
Tabs. 1 and 2 summarize the results of Sphere Encoder 2 on Oxford Flowers and ImageNet, respectively.
For both datasets, we generate 50K images and report FDr 6 ( Yang et al., 2026 ) and gFID ( Heusel et al., 2017 ) against the whole training set.
We prioritize FDr 6 over gFID, since it averages over six feature spaces rather than Inception alone, which provides a more robust evaluation of generation quality.
For Sphere2 models, the sampling angle ( Sec. B.4 ) and guidance angle ( Sec. B.5 ) are chosen by FDr 6 , and gFID is reported at the same setting rather than tuned separately, since the two metrics prefer different settings.
All training and evaluation details are in App. D .

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
Sphere Encoders are an emerging paradigm with progress from several teams ( Do et al., 2026 ; Man et al., 2026 ) , generating images with few steps and low compute.
Sphere Encoder 2 takes this paradigm a step further, matching the image quality of more expensive diffusion models while keeping that simplicity and speed.
It closes the gap to the equator with an explicit rotation, and splits the rotation arc into reconstruction and generation regimes on the same sphere.
The generation regime is trained with a simple objective: semantic alignment and latent consistency keep generated images semantically faithful to the input but structurally different, and a lightweight score matching loss sharpens them without adversarial training.
Several other families also targeted one-step generation from scratch, including consistency models, MeanFlow and its variants, drifting models, and GANs.
Sphere Encoder 2 adds a complementary path to this landscape by bringing the autoencoder back as a generator in its own right and could be a viable candidate for one/few-step generation.
blocks.zh:
Sphere Encoders是一个新兴的范式,有来自多支团队的进步(Do等,2026;Man等,2026),生成的图像没有多少步骤,计算率也很低.
Sphere Encoder 2使这个范式更进一步,匹配了更昂贵的传播模型的图像质量,同时保持了这种简单和速度.
它通过明确的旋转来将空隙与赤道相接,将旋转弧分割成同一领域的重建和生成制度.
生成制度的培训有一个简单的目标:语义相接和潜在一致性使生成的图像对输入具有强烈的忠诚,但结构上有所不同,一个轻量级的分数匹配损失使其在不经过对抗性训练的情况下更加尖锐.
其他几个家庭也从零开始针对一步骤的一代,包括一致性模型、MeanFlow及其变体、漂流模型和GANs。
Sphere Encoder 2通过将自動編碼器本身作为发电机带回来,从而为这个地貌增加了一个互补路径,并且可以作为一相/相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相

This is a mirror image of the metric paradox in FDr 6 ( Yang et al., 2026 ) : most generators beat gFID but not the eye, while ours satisfies the modern feature spaces but not gFID.

Where the drift is. We train Sphere2-B and Sphere2-L on ImageNet 256 × 256 256\times 256 with and without ℒ FD ​ - ​ lite \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{FD\text{-}lite}} for 100 epochs from the same initial start, and report FDr 6 in each feature space in Tab. A4 .
The Inception space is where the regularizer acts: its FDr drops by 34 34 – 46 % 46\% for both models at every step count (Incep. column in Tab. A4 ), which is the gFID improvement in Tab. 2 .
The other five modern spaces move far less, mostly by single digits, confirming that the drift is specific to the decade-old Inception space rather than a general mismatch.

其他5个现代空间移动的要少得多,多以单位数字表示,证实漂移是十年之久的受体空间所特有的,而不是一般的不匹配.

blocks.en:
Model size matters. Sphere2-B benefits in every space at every step count.
Sphere2-L benefits at 2 and 4 steps, but at 1 step its overall FDr 6 gets worse by 17 % 17\% : the Inception term improves as before, but ConvNeXt, MAE, SigLIP and CLIP all degrade ( Fig. A16 , right).
We read this as a capacity effect.
The smaller decoder has slack to satisfy the extra constraint, while the larger decoder, which already matches the modern spaces closely without the regularizer, trades some one-step fidelity in those spaces for the Inception match.
Multi-step sampling recovers the loss, since each refinement step re-encodes the image and pulls it back toward the real manifold.

我们把这看成是一种能力效应。
更小的解码器松懈地满足了额外的制约,而更大的解码器在没有正则器的情况下已经紧密地匹配了现代空间,却在这些空间中交换出一些单步的忠心来进行入想相配.
多步骤取样可以弥补损失,因为每一步的改进都会重新编码图像,并把它拉回真正的多面体。

blocks.en:
Relation to FD loss. We call ours ℒ FD ​ - ​ lite \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{FD\text{-}lite}} because it differs from the original FD loss ( Yang et al., 2026 ) in purpose, and as a result in cost.
The original is a post-training objective: it is the only loss applied to a pretrained multi-step generator, and its job is to repurpose the generator for one-step generation, which visibly and dramatically improves one-step quality.
Ours is a regularizer.
It runs alongside our other three losses throughout training with a small weight of 0.1 0.1 , and only keeps the statistics of already plausible samples from drifting particularly in the Inception space.
Being a regularizer rather than the main objective, it does not need the heavy extractors of the original, Inception, SigLIP-so400M and MAE-Large, and reuses the two we already run in our loss functions.
blocks.zh:

原作是训练后的目标:这是被应用到预先训练的多步发电机上的唯一损失,它的工作是将发电机重新用于一步生成,这明显并显著地提高了一步的质量.
我们的是一个常客。
它与我们整个训练期间的另外三个损失并列,重量小于0.1 0.1, 并且只保留了已经可信的样本的统计数字, 特别是在受体空间漂移。
作为常态化器而不是主要目标,它不需要原作,Inception,SigLIP-so-400M和MAE-Large等重取器,并重新使用我们已经运行在损失功能中的两种.

blocks.en: B.3 Angle Distribution in Training

blocks.en:
Diffusion models commonly concentrate training samples in the high-noise region, via a noise-level ( Li & He, 2026 ) or timestep shift ( Esser et al., 2024 ) .
Sphere Latent Encoder ( Do et al., 2026 ) likewise found that concentrating samples at high-angle noise improves generation.
One might expect Sphere Encoder 2 to benefit from more training at high angles as well, especially since its decoder is conditioned on α \alpha .
To test this expectation, we train a Sphere2-B on Oxford Flowers 256 × 256 256\times 256 and control the sampling density of α \alpha during training with a single parameter by drawing it from a rational curve: α = 90 ∘ ⋅ ( k + 1 ) ​ r k ​ r + 1 , r ∼ 𝒰 ⁡ [ 0 , 1 ] , \displaystyle\alpha=90^{\circ}\cdot\frac{(k+1)\,r}{k\,r+1},\quad r\sim\mathcal{U}[0,1], (A16) where k > − 1 k>-1 sets the shape of the curve ( Fig. A20 left).
Setting k = 0 k=0 gives uniform sampling.
A positive k k concentrates samples near the equator, and a negative k k near the pole. Fig. A20 middle and right tell a different story from common practice.

blocks.en:
Uniform sampling ( k = 0 k=0 ) gives the best 1-step gFID, and the best FDr 6 at every step count.
Concentrating samples near the equator ( k > 0 k>0 ) buys only a marginal gain in multi-step gFID at k = 5 k=5 .
We attribute this to the angle cutoff: each regime already receives a loss tailored to it, so the decoder no longer needs an uneven sampling density to prioritize the generation.
We therefore use uniform sampling by default, as the simplest and most effective choice.

blocks.en: C.1 Differentiable Augmentation
blocks.zh: C.1 可区别的增加

blocks.en:
We apply differentiable augmentations ( Zhao et al., 2020 ) to the decoder output before it is passed to the frozen feature extractor ϕ \phi during score model training.
The decoder produces images of size 256 × 256 256\times 256 or 512 × 512 512\times 512 , and we mainly investigate DINO-S/8 ( Caron et al., 2021 ) and ConvNeXt V2-N(ano) ( Woo et al., 2023 ) as the feature extractor.
For DINO-S/8, instead of resizing the image to 224 × 224 224\times 224 , we interpolate the positional embedding to match the image size.
We use two differentiable augmentations: horizontal flip with probability 0.5, and translation with probability 1.0.
The translation ratio is 0.015625 0.015625 for both resolutions, i.e., up to 4 pixels at 256 × 256 256\times 256 and 8 pixels at 512 × 512 512\times 512 , with reflect padding.
The translation smooths the patch boundaries.
Since DINO-S/8 uses 8 × 8 8\times 8 patches, a shift of up to 4 or 8 pixels is half a patch at 256 × 256 256\times 256 and a full patch at 512 × 512 512\times 512 , so the extractor sees the generated image at every offset relative to its patch grid.
